description: Alberta Health Community Profiles combine facility-location maps and health-service indicators for 132 local geography areas and health zones. The fifth-edition dashboard describes a Guest option; present access and exports remain unverified. Forty-nine companion XLSX packages identify editions published in 2013, 2015, 2019 and 2022. Measures include emergency visits by weekday/time and triage urgency, ambulatory/inpatient care within or outside the resident area, inpatient separation counts/rates, immunisation, primary-care-need indicators and top-three non-local acute/ambulatory facilities. Triage tables distinguish five urgency levels or semi-urgent/non-urgent subsets. Inpatient rates use separations per 1,000 residents; a 2013–2020 emergency table uses visits per 100,000. Mental-health tables compare zone and provincial use by age/gender and treatment-service type for 2017–2018 and 2020–2021; provincial totals include some people whose residence cannot be assigned to a zone. Titles span fiscal windows within 2003–2021 and single-year figures for 2010, 2011–2012, 2013–2014, 2017–2018 and 2020–2021. Immunisation covers 2017 and 2020. Native starts in 1986, 1988, 1990, 1993, 1995, 1997, 2000 or 2002 conflict with title periods. The 2018–2021 triage title also conflicts with a most-recent-year description. Related editions, measures and geographies remain distinct; neither a continuous common series nor diagnosed morbidity is inferred. Primary-care indicators compare areas with the province to identify service gaps. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves Alberta identities and descriptors under Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current access, numerical contents and specific simulation applications remain unverified. No workbook, dashboard data or document body was retrieved.
